thread:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — p95 token latency for /generate jumped ~30% for workspace 'acme' after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/workspace-kpis
metrics-bot: ALERT: workspace=acme route=/generate p95_tokens_ms increased from 120 -> 160 over 3h :warning:
Maria Lopez: ugh, saw a similar blip on a subset of tenants. Any idea if it's batching related or kernel fallback?
Alex Chen: I ran a lightweight profile locally. The runtime is swapping kernels more frequently at seq_len ~512; kernel selection eval adds ~8ms per request and our batch builder serializes some header work. snippet:```text
batch_builder: build_time_ms=5.2 -> 13.7
kernel_selector: eval_ms=1.1 -> 9.6
kv_cache_lookup_ms=2.0
```
Jordan Patel: on prod we also saw increased KV cache evictions for hot-prefixes around same window. eviction_rate for acme rose from 0.2% -> 1.9% which amplifies seq resyncs.
Devon Singh: sounds like multiple compounding factors. Two ideas: 1) add per-org metric tags for kernel_choice and batch_size at token granularity, 2) quick rollback of the selector change for heavy-workspace route while we instrument.
Maria Lopez: +1 on per-org kernel_choice metrics. Also we need RBAC gating on those dashboards so SRE can see tenant metrics but sales/support cannot. Can we implement workspace-scoped panels with role filtering?
Alex Chen: I sketched metric labels we'd need. Proposed PromQL labels:```yaml
redwood_latency_tokens_ms_bucket{workspace="<ws>",route="/generate",kernel_variant="fv2",batch_size="8"}
redwood_kernel_choice_count{workspace="<ws>",kernel_variant="fv2",decision="selected"}
redwood_kv_eviction_total{workspace="<ws>",prefix_hotness="true"}
```
Maria Lopez: perfect. For dashboards: add a token-latency breakdown panel that stacks kernel_variant and batch_size so we can see which combo regresses. Also add an annotation when deploy-bot posts a rollout.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T18:42:21 by @devon: rollout kernel-selector v1.3 -> v1.4 to canary (10% nodes)
Jordan Patel: can we also emit a per-route SLO metric that accounts for token-level cost? e.g., route_token_cost_usd so product teams see economical impact per tenant.
Devon Singh: yes, Optimize can plumb an estimator, but first infra needs kernel_choice & batch metrics to compute accurate per-token cost.
Alex Chen: action items: 1) instrument kernel_choice + batch_size + workspace labels (owner: Alex) 2) add RBAC-filtered dashboard & token-breakdown panel (owner: Maria) 3) short rollback candidate (Devon) 4) compute per-route token_cost prototype (Jordan). I'll open PRs today.
Maria Lopez: can you include a small sampling headroom for metrics to avoid high-cardinality explosion? Suggest quantizing batch_size to {1,2,4,8,16,32} and kernel_variant dot prefixes.
Alex Chen: yep — will quantize and add sampling flag in PR.
Jordan Patel: thanks — once metrics are in, I’ll re-run the perf sweep and post a before/after diffs to this thread. :+1:
metrics-bot: NOTE: New metric namespaces created: redwood_kernel_choice_count, redwood_batch_config_observed, redwood_workspace_token_latency (see docs: https://docs.redwood.internal/metrics/tenant-metrics)
Devon Singh: scheduling a rollback window at 02:00 UTC if we don't see improved p95 after instrumentation.
Alex Chen: cool — I'll link PRs here when ready. If anyone sees a sudden spike, ping me @here. 
Maria Lopez: thanks — this feels actionable. I'll draft the dashboard layout and drop screenshots in the thread once it's up. 
Jordan Patel: will follow up with KV hot-prefix probe results after instrumentation.
